queries: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS average_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_win_rate) AS mean_team_average FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.average_win_rate, t.record_count, t.average_win_rate - o.mean_team_average AS difference FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH team_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team), team_averages AS (SELECT t.team_id, AVG(1.0 * m.w / NULLIF(m.g, 0)) AS average_win_rate, COUNT(m.team_id) AS record_count FROM team_ids AS t LEFT JOIN manager_half AS m ON m.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_win_rate) AS mean_team_average FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.average_win_rate, t.record_count, t.average_win_rate - o.mean_team_average AS difference FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND g <> 0 AND w IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 * w / g END) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_team_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT tr.team_id, tr.avg_win_rate, tr.record_count, tr.avg_win_rate - o.mean_team_rate AS difference FROM team_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A team means a team_id across all years; only team_ids present in manager_half are included. Records with zero games have no win rate, but still count as records.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every distinct team_id in the team table, including teams with no manager_half records.

A missing win rate includes records with NULL wins or games, or zero games; AVG ignores those records.
